notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.2.9

Improved
- Car report PDF in Chinese, Japanese and Korean shows every letter (before, many came out as question marks).
- Fault scan: green and red results in every language, not only in English.
- Coding: searching the ready-made changes finds both the words on screen and the English names.
- Home: car model names in the garage are in your language ("5er Limousine", "5シリーズ セダン"); Japanese and Korean lines read correctly, the Ethernet status is named in Chinese, Japanese and Korean, Japanese badge names and Korean numbers no longer break mid-word, the car's build month is written the local way, and every status fits in the smaller window.
- Coding ideas and Retrofits: the number of modules and the "or" between module names read right in every language; long retrofit names are shown whole.
- Chinese, Japanese and Korean: the toolbar, the E-Sys MAX menu, the CAFD editor panel, drop-down lists and search boxes now use the language's clear font (before, letters stood wide apart); hints in empty lists wrap inside the list.
- SVT tools: the search box shows its whole hint in every language.
- Coding history: each copy's date is shown once, not twice.
- Job report: the job is named in your language ("Coding (changed settings)"), as in the car report.
- Code several changes and Car recovery: every progress line and every reason a file is left out is now in your language.
- The version list fades softly at the bottom when more versions follow.
- Romanian, Russian, Italian, Spanish and Turkish: Home status lines fit the small window and Spanish dates read naturally; in Turkish and other languages the "best value" label no longer breaks in the middle.
- CAFD editor: the module name is shown in your language. With German code names, codes whose BMW text is only a planning note show their real name.
- Many small fixes.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
